#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int u, flow, rid, cost;
    Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d): u(a), flow(b), cost(c), rid(d) {}
};

class MinCostMaxFlow {
public:
    vector<Edge> *al;
    vector<vector<Edge>> ja;
    int *d;
    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    const int gmax = INT_MAX / 100;
    int edges;

    int *node, *visit, *prv, *prve, *dist;
    int *a, *f;
    int n, m, k, c, d_const, a_arr[1001], f_arr[1001];

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n_, int s, int t) {
        N = n_;
        S = s;
        T = t;
        maxFlow = 0;
        minCost = 0;
        al = new vector<Edge>[N];
        d = new int[N];
        node = new int[N];
        visit = new int[N];
        prv = new int[N];
        prve = new int[N];
        dist = new int[N];
        memset(d, 0x3f, N * sizeof(int)); // fill with large number
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = al[u].size(), lv = al[v].size();
        al[u].emplace_back(v, flow, cost, lv);
        al[v].emplace_back(u, 0, -cost, lu);
    }

    void convertToArray() {
        ja.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            ja[i].clear();
            for (auto &e : al[i]) {
                ja[i].push_back(e);
            }
            al[i].clear();
        }
    }

    bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) d[i] = INT_MAX / 10;
        d[S] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                for (auto &e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) {
                        d[e.u] = d[j] + e.cost;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (check) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                for (auto &e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool simple() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            node[i] = S;
            visit[i] = 0;
            prv[i] = -1;
            prve[i] = -1;
            dist[i] = gmax;
        }
        dist[S] = 0;
        int front = 1, back = 0;
        node[0] = S;

        while (front != back) {
            int u = node[back++];
            if (back == N) back = 0;
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < ja[u].size(); ++i) {
                auto &e = ja[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                    if (visit[e.u] == 0) {
                        node[front] = e.u;
                        front = (front + 1) % N;
                    } else if (visit[e.u] == 2) {
                        back = (back - 1 + N) % N;
                        node[back] = e.u;
                    }
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                    prv[e.u] = u;
                    prve[e.u] = i;
                    dist[e.u] = cdist;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    struct Pair {
        int F, S;
        Pair(int a, int b): F(a), S(b) {}
        bool operator<(const Pair &other) const {
            return S > other.S; // Reverse for min-heap
        }
    };

    bool dijkstra() {
        for (int i=0; i<N; i++) {
            dist[i] = gmax;
            visit[i]=0;
        }
        priority_queue<Pair> pq;
        dist[S]=0; pq.push(Pair(S,0));
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            if (dist[p.F] < p.S) continue;
            visit[p.F]=2;
            for (int i=0; i<(int)ja[p.F].size(); i++) {
                auto &e=ja[p.F][i];
                if (e.flow==0) continue;
                int cdist=p.S+(e.cost+d[p.F]-d[e.u]);
                if (cdist<dist[e.u]) {
                    if (visit[e.u]==2) return false;
                    pq.push(Pair(e.u, cdist));
                    dist[e.u]=cdist;
                    prv[e.u]=p.F;
                    prve[e.u]=i;
                    visit[e.u]=1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T]!=0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p=T, minFlow=gmax;
        while (p!=S) {
            int pp=prv[p], pe=prve[p];
            int val=ja[pp][pe].flow;
            minFlow = min(minFlow, val);
            p=pp;
        }
        p=T;
        while (p!=S) {
            int pp=prv[p], pe=prve[p];
            ja[pp][pe].flow -= minFlow;
            int rid = ja[pp][pe].rid;
            ja[p][rid].flow += minFlow;
            p=pp;
        }
        maxFlow += minFlow;
        return minFlow;
    }

    bool calSimple() {
        // bool possible = BellmanFord(true);
        // if (!possible) return false;
        while (simple()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
        return true;
    }

    void updPotential() {
        for (int i=0; i<N; i++) {
            if (visit[i]!=0) {
                d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
            }
        }
    }

    bool calWithPotential() {
        // bool possible=BellmanFord(false);
        // if(!possible) return false;
        while (dijkstra()) {
            int minVal = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
            minCost += minVal * augment();
            updPotential();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n,m,k,c,d;
    cin>>n>>m>>k>>c>>d;

    int maxl = n + k;
    int T = n * maxl + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow mc(T+1, 0, T);

    for (int i=1; i<=k; ++i) {
        cin>>mc.a_arr[i];
        mc.f_arr[mc.a_arr[i]]++;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
        if (mc.f_arr[i]==0) continue;
        mc.addEdge(0, i, mc.f_arr[i],0);
    }
    for (int i=2; i<=n; ++i) {
        for (int l=0; l<maxl-1; ++l) {
            mc.addEdge(l*n + i, (l+1)*n + i, k, c);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; ++i) {
        int a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        for (int l=0; l<maxl-1; ++l) {
            for (int p=1; p<=k; ++p) {
                if (a != 1)
                    mc.addEdge(n*l + a, n*(l+1) + b, 1, d* (2*p-1)+c);
                if (b != 1)
                    mc.addEdge(n*l + b, n*(l+1) + a, 1, d* (2*p-1)+c);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int l=1; l<maxl; ++l) {
        mc.addEdge(l*n + 1, T, k,0);
    }
    mc.convertToArray();
    // mc.calWithPotential();
    mc.calSimple();
    if (mc.maxFlow != k) {
        cout<<"BUG\n";
    } else {
        cout<<mc.minCost<<"\n";
    }

    delete[] mc.al;
    delete[] mc.d;
    delete[] mc.node;
    delete[] mc.visit;
    delete[] mc.prv;
    delete[] mc.prve;
    delete[] mc.dist;

    return 0;
}
